Definition / interpretation: Elapsed time from DOCS_SUBMITTED to REVIEW_STARTED.
Source / calculation: stage_events timestamps matched by application_id; 2,742 matched apps.
Caveat: Current human-review queue wait, not AI feedback time.

Definition / interpretation: Elapsed time from REVIEW_STARTED to KYC_VERIFIED.
Caveat: Elapsed event time, not necessarily active reviewer work time.

Definition / interpretation: KYC-verified applications with no DOC_RETURNED event.
95th percentile of review-start to KYC verification for no-correction subset.
Caveat: Historical elapsed-time benchmark for straightforward cases, not a universal SLA.
An applicant may have multiple correction events.

Definition / interpretation: Distinct application_id with at least one DOC_RETURNED event.
Caveat: Used as denominator for correction-recipient metrics.
Candidate for automated detection, not guaranteed automatic resolution or applicant-level coverage.

Definition / interpretation: AUTO_EXPIRED note says 'No response to document request in 10 days'.
Caveat: Verify unique-app mapping before reporting as unique people.

Definition / interpretation: Applications with more than one DOC_RETURNED event.
Source / calculation: 67 had 2; 4 had 3; total 71 applicants; 75 extra events.
Caveat: Only equals repeat WhatsApp messages if each event generated a separate message; confirm with message logs.
Do not confuse reupload events with applicants or correction requests.
Final certification includes training/exam; rulebook requires 15 training hours before exam.

Definition / interpretation: KYC verified is a pre-certification milestone; certified is final outcome.
Caveat: Do not label a KYC target as final certification time.

Definition / interpretation: Applicants who cleared document and KYC verification (kyc_verified_at not null) but never logged in to start training (training_started_at is null).
Caveat: Represents momentum loss from multi-day onboarding delay; not caused by document rejection.

Definition / interpretation: Fully burdened hourly cost per onboarding reviewer, including base compensation, benefits, workstation, and management overhead.
Caveat: Cost savings from AI are realized by handling higher applicant volume with current headcount or reassigning staff to high-value partner acquisition.

Definition / interpretation: Real-time PAN lookup against the central IRDAI POSP database performed prior to collecting documents.
Caveat: Requires an active IRDAI portal / BAP API credential. If external registry is down, system falls back to asynchronous check.

Definition / interpretation: Share of applications that are ingested, cross-verified, and approved by AI with zero human touch and zero compliance errors.
Source / calculation: Clean APPROVE decisions with no human escalation / total applications; target ≥60%.
Caveat: Any case involving a hard reject recommendation (e.g. NAME_MISMATCH) or face match 0.60–0.75 must break straight-through flow for human confirmation.
